recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a shirtless man with curly hair standing in a narrow suburban alleyway. The scene is captured with a vintage film aesthetic, featuring heavy grain, muted greens, and a slightly overexposed sky. The background includes power lines, weathered wooden structures with a basketball hoop, and plastic waste bins.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a receding perspective of an alleyway
Contrast between the organic form of the human body and the industrial textures of the alley
Muted color palette unifying the natural foliage and man-made debris

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot, subject occupies the lower two-thirds of the vertical center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's crossed arms and direct gaze.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Leading lines from the alleyway and power lines draw the eye from the background to the central figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant upper third occupied by sky and power lines, providing breathing room for the busy background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted sage green and asphalt grey providing a neutral base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale skin tones against the darker background elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Occasional pops of orange and blue from the trash bin lids.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a compressed dynamic range, typical of expired film stocks.
paletteRestrictions: Limit pure blacks; use dark charcoal instead

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a black rectangular border

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family in a boxed container for utility.
graphicDevices: Black rectangular border for text block

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-density, blocky aesthetic of standard advisory labels.
Provides a clean, industrial look that fits the urban setting.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 35mm film-style photograph of a shirtless man with curly hair standing in a suburban alleyway. The background should feature a weathered white garage with a basketball hoop, power lines, and trash bins. Use a muted, desaturated color palette with heavy film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a small, black rectangular box in the bottom-left corner. Inside the box, add three lines of white, bold, condensed sans-serif text in all caps, centered and stacked.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain visible and consistent?
Is the subject centered with a direct gaze?
Are the colors desaturated and leaning towards greens/greys?
Is the text block positioned correctly in the bottom-left?

adjustableVariables: Specific items in the alleyway (e.g., car model, bin colors)
Time of day (overcast vs. golden hour)
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the bins or clothing
Identifiable street signs or house numbers
The specific wording of the advisory label
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the skin tones look natural under the film filter
Check that the power lines create a realistic perspective
Verify the basketball hoop looks weathered and integrated into the garage
Confirm the square crop is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central, candid human subject with a gritty, mundane suburban environment using a 35mm film aesthetic and a small, boxed typographic element in the corner for a lo-fi editorial look.
